name: @pipeworx/mcp-jsonplaceholder

tools.name: get_posts
tools.description: Fetch all fake blog posts for testing and prototyping. Returns post ID, user ID, title, and body text.

limit.description: Maximum number of posts to return (default 10, max 100).

tools.name: get_post
tools.description: Fetch a single fake blog post by ID (e.g., "1"). Returns post ID, user ID, title, and body text.

tools.name: get_users
tools.description: Fetch all fake users for testing. Returns name, username, email, address, phone, website, and company details.

tools.name: get_comments
tools.description: Fetch comments for a specific post by post ID (e.g., "1"). Returns comment ID, commenter name, email, and body text.

post_id.description: Post ID whose comments to retrieve (1–100).

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-jsonplaceholder forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the jsonplaceholder pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
